text:
A steel bar is placed in an East-West direction for it to be demagnetised. No other magnet is
nearby.
Which method is not suitable?
A
Hammering the bar.
B
Heating the bar to a very high temperature.
C
Slowly taking the bar out of a coil that carries an alternating current.
D
Slowly taking the bar out of a coil that carries a direct current.

options.label: B
options.text: Heating the bar to a very high temperature.

options.label: C
options.text: Slowly taking the bar out of a coil that carries an alternating current.

options.label: D
options.text: Slowly taking the bar out of a coil that carries a direct current.
